task:
You are a compliance analyst. Analyze the EU AI Act requirements for enterprise AI deployments. Work through this step by step:

Step 1: Search for and list all high-risk AI system categories under the EU AI Act.

Step 2: For each category found, research the specific compliance obligations separately. Do not combine categories.

Step 3: For each obligation, find one real company example of how it applies.

Step 4: Write a compliance checklist entry for each category before moving to the next.

Step 5: After all categories are done, identify the top 3 implementation challenges across them.

Important: Complete each step fully before moving to the next. Do not skip ahead.

reasons.REASONING_FIRST: The step begins with two full sentences of visible prose ('I will now search for all high-risk AI system categories...' and 'I'm searching for the official categorization...') before the tool call is made.
reasons.STEP_ANNOTATION: The step's visible text begins with '[STEP 1]' as required before any other content.
reasons.CITE_SOURCES: No search results have been returned yet in this step, so there are no factual claims drawn from search results to cite.
reasons.ACKNOWLEDGE_UNCERTAINTY: The agent explicitly states it is searching rather than recalling, noting it wants 'authoritative, current definitions rather than recollections,' which acknowledges the absence of retrieved evidence at this point.
reasons.SECTION_COMPLETE: This is the first step and no item or category has been finished yet, so no completion note is required.
